title: Model override grant
description: Authorises ONE governed harness run to pass --model, overriding an agent's pinned model. Fail-closed: absence of a grant is denial, and several fields are const so an over-broad grant is NOT REPRESENTABLE AS VALID. That is a claim about validation, not about what can be written — anyone can write the bytes; they will not validate. Single-use and task binding are enforced BEHAVIOURALLY by the validator, not by these declarations alone.

agentId.description: The exact agent. A grant naming no agent, or a wildcard, does not validate.

model.description: The exact model. Wildcards are refused by pattern: a grant must name what will run, not a family.

taskId.description: The task the override serves. Cross-checked by the validator against the task governing the invocation; the pattern alone would make it task-LABELLED rather than task-BOUND.

decisionRecord.description: The canonical record carrying the acceptance.

acceptedBy.description: Sole acceptance authority. A const, so a self-accepted grant does not validate.

reason.description: Why the pinned model is insufficient for this run. Length floor deters a placeholder.

reversal.description: How the run is undone. If it cannot be described, it is not reversible.

singleUse.description: A const, so a standing override does not validate. Enforcement is behavioural: the validator records the grant's content digest in a ledger under an exclusive lock and refuses a digest already present. This field alone would be a declaration.
